<b>Flintstone</b> is a material found in volcanic regions of [[Pharloom]]. It can be displayed in the [[Materium]].

== Use ==
Flintstone chunks can be found in containers, in rock deposits, or thrown by [[Flintstone Flyer]]s and [[Flintbeetle]]s. They explode on contact with Hornet or other enemies, or {{MissingInfo}} seconds after being thrown by enemies or scattered by the [[Needle]]. Hornet can strike loose chunks with her Needle to knock them away or even toward enemies. Flintstones that are knocked into enemies deal 6 damage on contact, or 5 damage when they explode after {{MissingInfo}} seconds.

Flintstone walls and floors also appear in volcanic areas. These can be walked or climbed on, but deal {{Damage|1|type=Fire}} after 0.7 seconds of continuous contact (2.7 seconds if the [[Magma Bell]] is equipped). Jumping frequently or using the [[Swift Step]] can allow Hornet to safely clear these obstacles.
Enemies take 3 damage every 0.5 seconds of continuous contact with Flintstone surfaces, and objects such as [[Rosaries]], [[Shell Shards]], and enemy corpses burn after {{MissingInfo}} seconds, turning into ash and becoming unobtainable.

== Location ==
Flintstone can be found in the [[Deep Docks]], the [[Far Fields]], the [[Whiteward]], the [[Underworks]], and during the climb out of [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]]. A Materium entry for Flintstone can be acquired in the lower Deep Docks.
